name: Shardmother · Ember style
role: Boss style · Ember Spires splinter rooms · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as the Shardmother; only textures and added boxes change.
A forge-crab: basalt shell with magma cracks, obsidian crystals, and egg sacs that glow like hot coals.
Her adds are Cinder Mites; in the Ember Spires her Splinter Volley can leave small fires (config).
Spawns in Ember Spires splinter rooms.
